result.description: A fictional 27-inch hybrid desktop monitor built for illustration work, office productivity, and casual media viewing. The Lumen Arc 27Q pairs a QHD panel with a matte anti-glare finish, a USB-C input for single-cable laptop connection, and a slim stand with tilt and height adjustment. It is positioned as a general-purpose display rather than a storage or graphics component, and includes built-in stereo speakers and an ambient light sensor for automatic brightness tuning.
result.title: Lumen Arc 27Q Hybrid Monitor
